MeterEventType.description:
Members:

  • 1 - This event is reserved for a meter value datalogger entry
  • 2 - The meter has been restarted
  • 3 - We have power down on all phases. The meter shuts down
  • 4 - The power has been disconnected from phase 1 on the meter.
  • 5 - The power has been disconnected from phase 2 on the meter.
  • 6 - The power has been disconnected from phase 3 on the meter.
  • 7 - The meter has detected a "open cover"
  • 8 - The meter has detected a magnetic field. If this occurs, the meter must be visited due to a fraud mistake
  • 9 - The RTC clock was adjusted.
  • 10 - The voltage on all phases has exceeded the limit for overvoltage detection
  • 11 - The voltage on all phases has exceeded the limit for undervoltage detection.
  • 12 - The voltage on L1 has exceeded the limit for overvoltage detection
  • 13 - The voltage on L2 has exceeded the limit for overvoltage detection
  • 14 - The voltage on L3 has exceeded the limit for overvoltage detection
  • 15 - A charging transaction from a pico charging station
  • 16 - A panic message from the pico controller
  • 17 - A panic message from the pico MID service
  • 18 - Pico Warning: the RCD has triggered
  • 19 - Pico Warning: the cable can not be locked
  • 20 - Pico Warning: a diode failure
  • 21 - Pico Warning: pico has detected a current overload
  • 22 - Pico Warning: the internal temperature is too high
  • 23 - A LogBook Entry when a parameter has changed (e.g. Impulse Values)
  • 24 - A LogBook Entry when the device went down (with date/time) and comes up again (with date/time)
  • 25 - A LogBook Entry when there was a general phase error. More Data in the error code field
  • 26 - The general error was reset (everything is fine again)
  • 27 - A fatal error (see details in the error code)
  • 28 - The Magnet Field is fine again
  • 29 - The tamper detection is fine again (cover is closed)
  • 30 - The clock was adjusted with the old date/time and the new date/time
  • 31 - The update of the MSP430 Firmware (with OldFirmware Version and NewFirmware Version)
  • 32 - The update of the communication Module Firmware (with OldFirmware Version and NewFirmware Version)
  • 33 - Event that the internal logbook of the meter is full
  • 257 - Loadprofile (Datalogger values) with Active Energy import and export and the reactive energy. And the OCMF signature
  • 65535 - InvalidValue
